# `{CVPASapp}`

## Installation

The CVPAS app code is housed within an R package. To run the app locally you will neeed to navigate to the root directory 'CVPASapp' then run the following code to:

```{r eval=TRUE,comment=""}
fs::dir_tree(type="directory")
```

## Running the app

```{r, eval = FALSE}

# loads all of the required functions into your environment
devtools::load_all("CVPASapp")

launches the application
CVPASapp::run_app()
```
